items.text: Week 2 injury beneficiaries on waivers: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; Dylan Sampson=Raheim Sanders; others.
items.why: Precise mapping of injured starters to available handcuffs/backups for Week 2.
items.implication: Priority adds for immediate opportunity spikes.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3. Same left knee as prior PCL sprain/bone bruise last season—scary.
items.why: Meniscus trim; Schefter/ETR note realistic W2 chance but knee history concerns.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer benefits if out, Bowers elite TE1 if active.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs/chest) day-to-day after leaving early Week 1; Harbaugh monitoring, testing to determine severity.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; left early, DTD per coach/Rapoport.
items.implication: Tre Harris/others elevated if out; monitor Wed practice.

items.text: A.J. Brown (high ankle sprain) to IR, expected 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle more severe than initial; IR placement.
items.implication: Long-term absence; Doubs/Douglas etc. waiver bumps per ETR.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious; day-to-day, MRI, likely would have returned if playoff game. Exploded for 5-150-1 before exit.
items.why: Hamstring tweak (prior camp issue); sources say minor.
items.implication: High chance play Week 2; Bateman/Moore elevated if limited/out.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week per FFHappyHour.
items.why: Highlighted as top waiver amid WR injuries (Stribling etc.).
items.implication: Strong add for target upside in new situation.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, only 2.5 last night with just 2 targets (7% share). Routes strong: 29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind only Worthy 30). Needs volume to produce.
items.why: High route participation but tiny aDOT and low target share in debut.
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR; monitor for target growth or risk underwhelming.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in Chiefs debut, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), finished 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominant early opportunity share and dual-threat involvement with Mahomes.
items.implication: High-end RB1 with elite volume floor ROS in KC offense.

items.text: Dylan Sampson (knee) to IR; out at least 4 games. Raheim Sanders beneficiary (ran 13 routes in W1 after early exit).
items.why: Knee injury early W1, crutches/brace, IR designation.
items.implication: Sanders/Judkins elevated CLE RB work; drop Sampson most leagues.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att +6 tgt, 156 scrimmage yds +2 TD. Utilization 99, high-end RB1 upgrade.
items.why: Dominant every-down share in new scheme/OL.

items.text: Travis Etienne (Kamara out) only 53 snaps/24 routes/18 opps vs Kendre Miller 26/5/9 and Donaldson. Did not dominate as hoped.
items.why: Committee even without Kamara; low route share.
items.implication: ETR/Berry note Miller waiver; Etienne low-end RB2 risk.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game since 9/28/25 ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% team-high share), 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: Encouraging snap/route/target share post-major knee injury.
items.implication: On track for WR1 role; ramp-up possible but volume already strong.

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full grown man after MNF explosion; Monday Night Miracle love.
items.why: Post-game praise for dominant Chiefs debut performance.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 dropbacks W1 even after Sampson (knee) early exit; Browns used Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Limited passing involvement despite backfield injury.
items.implication: More runner than receiver; Sanders handcuff value up.
